tasks.name: ElysiumDB
tasks.description: Prepare the next release of ElysiumDB and finalize the documentation for the new extension system.

tasks.name: Extension pipeline
tasks.description: Improve extension process ordering and make sure dependent extensions are executed in the correct sequence.

tasks.name: Process synchronization
tasks.description: Implement reliable waiting between extension processes and prevent race conditions when multiple extensions are executed.

tasks.name: Documentation
tasks.description: Write examples explaining how to create custom database extensions and configure their execution order.

tasks.name: Authentication package
tasks.description: Move AuthElysiumDB into a separate package and prepare the API for independent installation.

tasks.name: Badge Generator
tasks.description: Create a flexible SVG badge generator with animated effects, customizable colors, indicators, and automatic text wrapping.

tasks.name: SVG rendering
tasks.description: Improve the generated SVG appearance and experiment with glow filters, masks, gradients, and animated elements.

tasks.name: GitHub integration
tasks.description: Add support for generating badges that can be embedded directly into GitHub README files and project documentation.

tasks.name: Templates
tasks.description: Design several badge templates demonstrating different visual styles and information layouts.

tasks.name: Neural Network
tasks.description: Continue experimenting with a handwritten digit recognition network trained on the MNIST dataset.

tasks.name: Training pipeline
tasks.description: Optimize the training loop and experiment with learning rates, data augmentation, and network architecture.

tasks.name: Visualization
tasks.description: Create a simple interface for drawing digits and displaying the network prediction together with the confidence values.

progress.description: The task takes priority and is at the forefront of the work process.

active.description: The task is in the queue for execution.

archived.description: The task is archived, either completed or abandoned.
